想.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 相 represents the sound.
w: to think of; to call to mind; to anticipate
to want to; to feel like; to fancy
to recall; to think of; to call to mind
x: 我想不起他的名字。
Wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ tā de míngzi.
I can't recall his name.
他是这一学派思想的集大成者。
Tā shì zhè yī xuépài sīxiǎng de jídàchéng zhě.
He epitomized the thought of this school.
我从来没有想到他是那本小说的作者。
Wǒ cónglái méiyǒu xiǎngdào tā shì nà běn xiǎoshuō de zuòzhě.
It never occurred to me that he was the author of that novel.

女.o: Depicts a woman sitting or squatting down.
x: 请问女卫生间在哪儿？
Qǐngwèn nǚ wèishēngjiān zài nǎr?
Excuse me, where is the ladies' lavatory?; Excuse me, where is the women's bathroom?
我不想和这种不要脸的女人讲话。
Wǒ bù xiǎng hé zhè zhǒng bùyàoliǎn de nǚrén jiǎnghuà.
I don't wish to speak to such a shameless woman.
他接住了从楼上跳下来的女孩。
Tā jiē zhù le cóng lóu shàng tiào xiàlái de nǚhái.
He caught the girl who jumped from the building.
co: a letter from an unknown woman
to give a daughter in marriage; to try to marry off a daughter

c.h: The traditional component 門 was removed for simplification.

c.g: to run threads through a web in weaving
c.h: Shorthand for the 𢇇 component in the traditional character 關.

关.o: Phonosemantic compound. 門 represents the meaning and 𢇇 represents the sound. The simplified character 关 was adapted from the cursive form of the traditional character 關. The traditional component 門 was removed for simplification.
rad: “ears-out” component used in some Chinese characters (e.g. U+5151 兑)
w: pertaining to; concerning; with regard to
to have sth to do with; to relate to
to pay attention to; to follow sth closely
to be concerned about; to care about
x: 这件事与我无关。
Zhè jiàn shì yǔ wǒ wúguān.
This has nothing to do with me.
这份的文件需要特别关注。
Zhè fèn de wénjiàn xūyào tèbié guānzhù.
This document needs special attention.
该组织已经出台了相关的指导文件。
Gāi zǔzhī yǐjīng chūtái le xiāngguān de zhǐdǎo wénjiàn.
The organization has issued relevant guidelines.

c.h: Depicts the moving motion of striking.

平.o: Depicts using a staff (丂) for striking. Based on the original meaning "to strike", now written as 抨. The meaning later shifted to "level", "even", and "flat".
w: ordinarily; in normal times; in peacetime
x: 马路很平。
Mǎlù hěn píng.
The road is very flat.
他的技术水平绝对不在专家之下。
Tā de jìshù shuǐpíng juéduì bù zài zhuānjiā zhīxià.
His technical skill is definitely not inferior to that of a specialist.
双方都做了妥协以求和平。
Shuāngfāng dōu zuò le tuǒxié yǐqiú hépíng.
Both sides have made compromises in order to achieve peace.

至.o: Pictograph of an arrow hitting its target.
w: as for; as to; to go so far as to
so far; to this day; until now
and even; to go so far as to
x: 这至少需要有人先出来带个头才行啊。
Zhè zhìshào xūyào yǒu rén xiān chūlái dài ge tóu cái xíng a.
At least someone needs to come out and take the lead.
中国传统绘画盛行至今。
Zhōngguó chuántǒng huìhuà shèngxíng zhìjīn.
Traditional Chinese painting is popular to this day.
我那失散多年的女儿至今还无着落。
Wǒ nà shīsàn duōnián de nǚ'ér zhìjīn hái wú zhuóluò.
The whereabouts of the daughter I lost years ago are still unknown.

c.h: Shorthand for the 氵 component in the traditional character 決. 氵 is a component form of 水.

决.o: Simplified form of 決. Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 夬 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "burst open". The meaning later shifted to "clear", "cut off", "decide" and "judge".
w: to decide (to do something); to resolve
to settle (a dispute); to resolve; to solve
judgment (by a court of law); to sentence
x: 她必须在黄昏前做出决定。
Tā bìxū zài huánghūn qián zuòchū juédìng.
She must make the decision before dusk.
问题得到了解决。
Wèntí dédào le jiějué.
The problem has been solved.
我们决不妥协。
Wǒmen juébù tuǒxié.
We will never compromise.

即.o: Depicts a kneeling person (卩) eating from a container of food (皀). Based on the original meaning "eat". The meaning later shifted to "come near", "approach", and "quickly".
w: on the eve of; to be about to
even if; even though; right away
equivalent to 就可以; can then (do sth)
x: 如遇紧急情况请即报警。
Rú yù jǐnjí qíngkuàng qǐng jí bàojǐng.
In an emergency situation, please call the police immediately.
如蒙需要，即可提供推荐信。
Rú méng xūyào, jíkě tígōng tuījiànxìn.
References available upon request.
天竺即今日之印度。
Tiānzhú jí jīnrì zhī Yìndù.
Tianzhu is the same as today's India.

害.o: Pictograph of a pointed spearhead. The distinguishing mark 口 was added later. Based on the original meaning "spearhead", now written as 𥎆. The meaning later shifted to "harm" and "injure".
w: to be afraid; to be scared
difficult to deal with; difficult to endure
casualty; victim; those injured and wounded
to jeopardize; to harm; to endanger
x: 航班晚点了，害我多等了两个小时。
Hángbān wǎndiǎn le, hài wǒ duō děng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
The flight was delayed, causing me to wait for another two hours.
我非常害怕。
Wǒ fēicháng hàipà.
I am very afraid.
吸烟危害健康。
Xīyān wēihài jiànkāng.
Smoking is harmful to health.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

傳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 專 represents the sound.

c.h: Depicts a tongue sticking out of the mouth.
Mark to distinguish 音 from 言.

音.o: Originally the same as 言 (speech) but with an extra line added in the mouth (口) to distinguish the two characters.
x: 你喜欢什么样的音乐？
Nǐ xǐhuān shénmeyàng de yīnyuè?
What kind of music do you like?
早期电影没有声音。
Zǎoqī diànyǐng méiyǒu shēngyīn.
In the early days, films were silent.
禁止录音。
Jìnzhǐ lùyīn.
No recording.

石.o: Pictograph of a musical stone chime. The 口 component was added later as a meaningless decorative mark.
x: 心里一块石头落了地。
Xīnlǐ yī kuài shítou luò le dì.
That's a load off my mind. (lit. "a stone in my heart fell to the ground")
我的腿被石头压住了。
Wǒ de tuǐ bèi shítou yā zhù le.
My legs were held down by rocks.

跳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 兆 represents the sound.
w: to jump; to leap; to bound
to jump out; fig. to appear suddenly
to throb; to pulse; to bounce
to jump from a building (to kill oneself)
x: 把手放在胸口，感受心脏的跳动。
Bǎ shǒu fàng zài xiōngkǒu, gǎnshòu xīnzàng de tiàodòng.
Place your hand over your chest and feel your heartbeat.
他最终承受不了残酷的结果，跳楼自尽了。
Tā zuìzhōng chéngshòu bùliǎo cánkù de jiéguǒ, tiàolóu zìjìn le.
He finally couldn't take the cruelty anymore and jumped to his death.
co: to have no breathing or heartbeat

w: square meter; short for 平方米
x: 我有一米九高。
Wǒ yǒu yī mǐ jiǔ gāo.
I'm 1.9 metres tall.
中国南方一般以大米为主食。
Zhōngguó nánfāng yībān yǐ dàmǐ wéi zhǔshí.
Southern Chinese usually eat rice as a staple food.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.
The purpose of this component is unclear.

陳.o: Composed of 阝 and 東. The purpose of 東 is unclear.

足.o: Pictograph of a foot (止) attached to a leg.
w: to satisfy; to meet (the needs of); satisfied
sufficient to...; so much so that; so that
x: 她似乎满足于做大款的玩物。
Tā sìhū mǎnzú yú zuò dàkuǎn de wánwù.
She seems content with her life as a rich man's plaything.
计划因资金不足而流产。
Jìhuà yīn zījīn bùzú ér liúchǎn.
The plan fell through due to a shortage of funding.
她的黑暗史足以写出一本书。
Tā de hēi'ànshǐ zúyǐ xiěchū yī běn shū.
Her dark past is enough to write a book.
co: to meet the actual demands of the market

味.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 未 represents the sound.
w: to signify; to mean; to imply
x: 味道有点怪。
Wèidào yǒudiǎn guài.
It tastes funny.
我想换个口味。
Wǒ xiǎng huàn ge kǒuwèi.
I'd like to try a new flavour.
他知道没有朋友的滋味。
Tā zhīdào méiyǒu péngyǒu de zīwèi.
He knows what it's like to be without friends.
co: the more one reads, the more intriguing [the book] becomes

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

河.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 可 represents the sound.
x: 泰晤士河是英国第二长的河流。
Tàiwùshì Hé shì Yīngguó dì'èr cháng de héliú.
The River Thames is the second longest river in the UK.
新运河将两条河连在一起。
Xīn yùnhé jiāng liǎng tiáo hé lián zàiyīqǐ.
The new canal links the two rivers.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.
Simplified from the traditional 陽. Used here since the sun corresponds to the 'Yang' of 'Yin and Yang' in Chinese philosophy.

阳.o: The traditional characters 陰 (Yin) and 陽 (Yang) were simplified to 阴 and 阳. In Chinese philosophy, the moon (月) corresponds to Yin (阴) and the sun (日) corresponds to Yang (阳).
w: to be in the sun (getting warm or sunbathing etc)
x: 太阳落山了。
Tàiyáng luòshān le.
The sun (∅/has/is) set.
他的生活不再晦暗，他的生活充满阳光。
Tā de shēnghuó bùzài huì'àn, tā de shēnghuó chōngmǎn yángguāng.
His life is no longer dull. His life is full of sunshine.
好大太阳！
Hǎo dà tàiyáng!
It's glaringly hot!

c.h: Shorthand for the 炏 (flame) component in the traditional character 勞.

劳.o: Simplified form of 勞. Depicts the hard work of sewing clothes (衣) with only firelight (炏). Later the 力 (strength, power) component was added.
w: to serve (in some capacity); to work for
x: 劳驾，把杯子递给我。
Láojià, bǎ bēizi dì gěi wǒ.
Would you mind passing me the cup?
前半生操劳，后半生享福。
Qiánbànshēng cāoláo, hòubànshēng xiǎngfú.
Work hard in the first half of your life and enjoy yourself in the second half.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

纳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 内 represents the sound. Simplified form of 納.
w: to bring into; to channel into
to hold; to contain; to accommodate
x: 这道题为什么这么做，我还是纳不过这个闷儿。
Zhèi dào tí wèishénme zhènme zuò, wǒ háishì nà bù guò zhèi ge mènr.
I still cannot figure out why this problem is solved this way.
公民有依法纳税的义务。
Gōngmín yǒu yīfǎ nàshuì de yìwù.
Citizens are obliged to pay taxes in accordance with the law.

右.o: Pictograph of a right hand. The 口 (mouth) component was added later to distinguish the character from 又.
w: right side; right, to the right
x: 他身高可能在三米左右。
Tā shēngāo kěnéng zài sān mǐ zuǒyòu.
He was about three meters tall.
我估计温度都在十度左右吧。
Wǒ gūjì wēndù dōu zài shí dù zuǒyòu ba.
I guess the temperature is around ten degrees now.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

腳.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 卻 represents the sound.

x: 别弹我的耳朵！
Bié tán wǒ de ěrduo!
Don't flick my ears!
竖起你们的耳朵。
Shùqǐ nǐmen de ěrduo.
Perk up your ears.

c.h: Shorthand for the phonetic 㥯 component in the traditional character 穩.

稳.o: Simplified form of 穩. Phonosemantic compound. 禾 represents the meaning and 㥯 represents the sound.
x: 病情趋向于稳定。
Bìngqíng qūxiàng yú wěndìng.
The condition [of the patient] is stabilizing.
他办事很把稳。
Tā bànshì hěn bǎwěn.
He is dependable in what he does.
co: to achieve a high level of efficiency, stability, and security

申.o: Depicts a lightning bolt. Based on the original meaning "lightning". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: to apply for sth; application (form etc)
to state to a superior, report; extend
x: 我第一次申请美国旅游签证被拒签了。
Wǒ dì yī cì shēnqǐng měiguó lǚyóu qiānzhèng bèi jùqiān le.
The first time I applied for a tourist visa for the United States I was rejected.
你申请新护照时，必须交出旧护照。
Nǐ shēnqǐng xīn hùzhào shí, bìxū jiāochū jiù hùzhào.
You must hand over your old passport when applying for a new one.

吳.o: Pictograph of a person (大) standing up, yelling with an open mouth (口).

廳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 广 represents the meaning and 聽 represents the sound.

c.g: to roll rice into a ball

x: 你再不走，别怪我拳头不长眼睛。
Nǐ zài bù zǒu, bié guài wǒ quántou bù zhǎng yǎnjing.
Leave now, or I will beat you up.
他打了我肚子一拳。
Tā dǎ le wǒ dùzi yī quán.
He punched me in the stomach.

琳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 王 represents the meaning and 林 represents the sound.
w: glittering jewels to delight the eye (idiom)
x: 商店里的商品琳琅满目。
Shāngdiàn lǐ de shāngpǐn línlángmǎnmù.
The shop is filled with a dazzling array of goods.

帳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 巾 represents the meaning and 長 represents the sound.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

泳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 永 represents the sound.
x: 禁止游泳。
Jìnzhǐ yóuyǒng.
No swimming.
她教我如何游泳。
Tā jiāo wǒ rúhé yóuyǒng.
She taught me how to swim.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

佳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 圭 represents the sound.
x: 此篇佳作配上如此佳题，有如画龙点睛。
Cǐ piān jiāzuò pèishàng rúcǐ jiā tí, yǒurú huàlóngdiǎnjīng.
Pairing this excellent piece with such a superb title is the finishing touch.

詳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 羊 represents the sound.

鳳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 鳥 represents the meaning and 凡 represents the sound. Originally a pictograph of a mythical Chinese bird, similar to a phoenix. Later the phonetic component 凡 was added.

柳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 卯 represents the sound. Simplified form of 栁.
w: lit. the willow trees make the shade, the flowers give the light…
x: 我家的柳树长出了新芽。
Wǒ jiā de liǔshù zhǎngchū le xīnyá.
The willows in our hometown have begun to sprout.
柳枝低垂在水面上。
Liǔ zhī dīchuí zài shuǐmiàn shang.
The branches of the willows drooped over the water.

c.h: 艹 is a component form of 艸.

芳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 艹 represents the meaning and 方 represents the sound.
w: the affection, or heart, of a young woman
(of one's name, reputation etc) to be immortalized (idiom)
all flowers; all beauties; all talents
x: 您女儿芳龄几何？
Nín nǚ'ér fānglíng jǐhé?
How old is your daughter? [honorific]
co: (of a girl) to be eighteen years of age

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

绳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 黾 represents the sound. Simplified form of 繩.
w: to punish according to the law
x: 这条绳子有两米长。
Zhè tiáo shéngzǐ yǒu liǎng mǐ cháng.
This rope is two meters long.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

澳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 奥 represents the sound.
x: 澳大利亚消费高吗？
Àodàlìyà xiāofèi gāo ma?
Is the cost of living in Australia high?
布里斯班是澳大利亚昆士兰州的首府。
Bùlǐsībān shì Àodàlìyà Kūnshìlán zhōu de shǒufǔ.
Brisbane is the capital of Queensland, Australia.

c.h: 爫 is a component form of 爪. Depicts a hand.

乳.o: Depicts a mother holding (爫) a child (子) breastfeeding it.
x: 母乳对宝宝的健康很好。
Mǔrǔ duì bǎobao de jiànkāng hěn hǎo.
Breast milk is very good for a baby's health.
这家店的乳酪蛋糕很有名。
Zhè jiā diàn de rǔlào dàngāo hěn yǒumíng.
This shop's cheesecake is very famous.

c.h: 糹 is a component form of 糸.

繳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 敫 represents the sound.

岳.o: A mountain 山 range surrounded by hills 丘
w: Mt Tai 泰山 in Shandong, one of the Five Sacred Mountains 五岳
x: 岳飞字鹏举。
Yuèfēi zì péng jǔ.
Yue Fei is styled with the courtesy name of Pengju.

c.h: 釒 is a component form of 金.

銳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 釒 represents the meaning and 兌 represents the sound.

c.h: A table is considered to be a hard object, much like a casing.

壳.o: Simplified form of 殼. Phonosemantic compound. 几 represents the meaning and 㱿 represents the sound.
x: 蒸水蛋时不能掌捏放多少水量，可直接用蛋壳来兑。
Zhēng shuǐ dàn shí bù néng zhǎngniē fàng duō shào shuǐliàng, kě zhíjiē yòng dànké lái duì.
When making egg soup, if you don’t know how much water to add, you can use the egg shells to measure it.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

胳.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 各 represents the sound. Simplified form of 肐.
x: 这孩子胳臂怎么给拽掉环儿啦？
Zhèi háizi gěbei zěnme gěi zhuài diàohuánr la?
How come this kid's arm is dislocated?

颳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 風 represents the meaning and 𠯑 represents the sound.

檳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 賓 represents the sound.

驳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 马 represents the meaning and 爻 represents the sound. Simplified form of 駁.
w: to reject; to turn down; to overrule
to refute; to debunk; to deny
x: 他的话让我无法反驳。
Tā de huà ràng wǒ wúfǎ fǎnbó.
I had no way to argue against what he said.
法院驳回了他的请求。
Fǎyuàn bóhuí le tā de qǐngqiú.
The court rejected his request.

馳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 馬 represents the meaning and 也 represents the sound.

艳.o: Lush 丰 and sexy 色
x: 我总艳羡我朋友的幸福。
Wǒ zǒng yànxiàn wǒ péngyou de xìngfú.
I've always envied the happiness of my friends.

c.h: 糹 is a component form of 糸.

紳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 申 represents the sound.

圳.o: A furrow cut in the earth 土 by a stream 川; 川 also provides the pronunciation
w: furrow in field, small drainage ditch
x: 深圳是一座年轻的城市。
Shēnzhèn shì yī zuò niánqīng de chéngshì.
Shenzhen is a young city.

w: Lord (UK hereditary nobility); UK life peer

聳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 耳 represents the meaning and 從 represents the sound.

x: 妳真是个好人。
Nǐ zhēnshì ge hǎorén.
You really are a good person.

恳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 艮 represents the sound. Simplified form of 懇.
w: to beg; to beseech; to entreat
x: 他道歉的态度非常诚恳。
Tā dàoqiàn de tàidu fēicháng chéngkěn.
He was very sincere in his apology.
孩子恳求妈妈再讲一个故事。
Háizi kěnqiú māma zài jiǎng yī gè gùshi.
The child begged his mother to tell one more story.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

扳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 反 represents the sound.
w: to pull back; to regain (one's dignity etc)
to pull out; to pull a lever
to equalize; to level the score
x: 请把那个扳手递给我。
Qǐng bǎ nàge bānshǒu dì gěi wǒ.
Please pass me that wrench.
我们队在下半场扳回了一球。
Wǒmen duì zài xiàbànchǎng bānhuí le yī qiú.
Our team pulled one goal back in the second half.

咳.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 亥 represents the sound.
w: to cough up phlegm; to expectorate
x: 她咳嗽的声音很大，吓了我一跳。
Tā késòu de shēngyīn hěn dà, xià le wǒ yī tiào.
Her huge cough startled me.
co: ké chū yī kǒu xiě lái
to cough up a mouthful of blood
